capabilities: show a single-letter status badge (A/M/D) next to each file name in the file explorer
indicate added, modified, and deleted states relative to Obsidian Publish
refresh publish status automatically on file switch and edit
refresh status manually via ribbon icon or command
extras: README is written in Japanese. Requires Obsidian v1.12.0 or later and the core Publish plugin to be enabled. MIT licensed.
intentEvidence: Obsidian Publish の公開ステータスを VSCode の Git ステータス風に表示する
problem: Obsidian's file explorer gives no indication of which notes are published, changed since publishing, or deleted relative to an Obsidian Publish site.

relations.evidence: VSCode の Git ステータス風に表示する

summary: Status-badge plugin that shows each note's Obsidian Publish state (added, modified, deleted) as a Git-style letter badge in the file explorer.
